headline: Mistakes to Avoid During Your Kitchen Plumbing Remodel
articleBody:
A kitchen remodel is a big project, and while you're focused on aesthetics, skipping over plumbing details can lead to some major regrets. Having been in the business for over 25 years, Alpha-Plumbing Services, LLC has seen the good, the bad, and the leaky when it comes to kitchen renovations. Here are some key mistakes to steer clear of.

Firstly, don’t overlook the importance of professional design input. Trying to fit new appliances and fixtures into an existing plumbing footprint without proper planning often leads to compromises or costly changes mid-project. A good plumber can advise on the best layout for functionality and code compliance. Second, reusing old shut-off valves or supply lines is a common oversight. While they might look fine, these components can be nearing the end of their lifespan and could fail shortly after your beautiful new kitchen is installed. Always opt for new, high-quality replacements. Third, ignoring drainage slope requirements is a big no-no. Drains need a proper slope to function efficiently. If they’re installed incorrectly, you’ll be dealing with slow drains and clogs in your brand-new kitchen. This is definitely a job for someone who knows the International Plumbing Code inside and out. Fourth, trying to install complex fixtures like garbage disposals, dishwashers, or water filtration systems without experience can lead to leaks or damage. Each requires precise connections and sealing. Fifth, forgetting about adequate water pressure for new fixtures is another common slip-up. If you’re adding multiple high-demand fixtures, your existing water supply lines might not be sufficient, leading to disappointing performance. Lastly, failing to protect existing plumbing during demolition and construction can cause accidental damage. Always make sure exposed pipes are shielded from debris and impacts. Alpha-Plumbing Services, LLC makes sure these details are handled for you.
